items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Then I started playing over there for Larry, playing for him.

ctx.x: So, and... Unless they want to get something decent.

Yeah, yeah, you see? So, well, so, well, after the place burnt down, the man burnt it down, the man that bought the place, I guess he burnt down, you know what I mean? It was going down in a hole, you know what I mean? So it's falling down, falling apart. So the man said, well, I guess the man must have set the fires up and get the insurance and get it done. It's really beautiful now, you know? They got a whole, the whole front is glass. And they already got a lot of doors. You can't, you ain't got no kick with…
